title: ‘A Tribute to PAC’: Here’s Where to Watch ‘AEW Dynamite’ Online for Free
summary: There are a number of ways to stream the weekly AEW TV event — watch online for free.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

After appearing on AEW All Out on Sunday (Sept. 26), pro wrestler PAC (born Benjamin Satterley) suddenly passed away at age 40 the following day while traveling to the next venue for AEW Dynamite . With the shocking news spreading throughout the wrestling world, AEW has a TV special, A Tribute to PAC , to honor his memory. It airs on Wednesday (Sept. 30).

Get DirecTV 5-Day Free Trial

AEW Dynamite broadcasts live on Wednesdays, with a start time of 8 p.m. ET/PT, on TBS .

How to Watch ‘AEW Dynamite’ 2026 Online, At a Glance:

- Date: Wednesdays

- Network: TBS

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Sling TV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , HBO Max

Who’s Performing During ‘AEW Dynamite’?

Throughout its history on TV, there have been a number of popular recording artists who made surprise appearances during AEW Dynamite , including JPEGMafia, T-Pain, Rick Ross, Action Bronson, Trina and others. To find out who’s going to appear on the show, tune in to Dynamite .

How to Watch ‘AEW Dynamite’ Online

For those with traditional cable, you can watch on Wednesdays on TBS starting at 8 p.m. ET/PT. However, if you don’t have cable then the best way to watch online is with a subscription to DirecTV , or HBO Max .

EDITOR'S CHOICE

DirecTV

Sling TV

Get Sling Blue

Sling TV offers the Blue plan, which comes with TBS. With more than 40 channels, the streaming plan goes for $54.99 per month. All plans come with a free cloud DVR and an extra 600 or so free channels too. Please note: Pricing and channel availability vary from market-to-market.

Fubo

Get Fubo 5-day Free Trial

With prices starting at $63.99 per month for the first month of service ($88.99 per month afterward), Fubo’s “Pro” plan is a cable-alternative streaming service that offers TBS. The plan features more than 230 other channels, including ABC, CBS, FOX, Bravo and others. Fubo comes with a five-day free trial too, so you can try out the service before you commit month-to-month.

Hulu + Live TV

Get Hulu + Live TV

If you don’t have a  Hulu + Live TV subscription, the streamer offers a  free trial  that’ll get you your first three days free to access TBS, as well as more than 100 other channels. Once the free trial is over, you’ll be charged the regular subscription fee, which is on sale for $49.99 for the first month ($99.99 per month afterward). For even more content, Hulu + Live TV bundles with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no extra cost to watch even more exclusive and original sporting events and programming.

HBO Max

Get HBO MAX

A subscription to HBO Max is the best way to watch AEW Dynamite online. The streaming service starts at $10.99 per month for the ad-supported plan. But you can get HBO Max bundled with Hulu and Disney+ starting at $21.99 per month for all three services.

HBO Max is the home of hit originals such as Hacks , House of the Dragon and The Last of Us ; all things HBO, including Succession , Veep and Industry ; popular movies, including Sinners, One Battle After Another , Dune , Barbie , Wonka and others, live sports from the MLB, NHL, NCAA and other leagues and much more.

The streaming service is also the home to exclusive Music Box documentaries, such as Yacht Rock: A DOCKumentary , Woodstock ’99: Peace, Love and Rage , Juice WLRD: Into The Abyss , DMX: Don’t Try to Understand and others.

With opening theme “You Wanted War” by Sum 41, AEW Dynamite is available to watch on Wednesdays, starting at 8 p.m. ET/PT, on TBS. The best way to watch online is with DirecTV .
